messages:
Priya Khatri: Quick sync — proposing a small change to the pilot entry gating before we open the next 50 invites. Want feedback on heuristics + operational SLAs.
Evan Cho: +1. What are you thinking for the heuristics?
Priya Khatri: Two-path model: (1) Fast-track invites for high-fit customers (enterprise usage, committed contact, >1 product integration) and (2) Curated cohort for discovery partners (diverse use cases, lower volume but high feedback signal).
Maya Lopez: Love the two-path idea. How do we score fit?
Priya Khatri: Proposed fit score (0-100): company fit (30), product integration (25), security/regulatory risk (15 negative weight possible), eval pass on a 5-prompt probe (20), willingness to take weekly check-ins (10). Thresholds: fast-track >=75, curated 45-74.
Samir Patel: Can we see the probe prompts? want to avoid biasing with examples. Also need to spike for private/on-prem asks.
Priya Khatri: Sure — sample probe (short):
```
1) Describe the primary user flow you want to ship with our API (max 3 bullets)
2) Share a short prompt + expected output for a critical success case
3) Estimate monthly token volume (rough ranges ok)
4) Any regulatory/PHI concerns? yes/no + short note
5) Would you take weekly 30 min check-ins for 6 weeks? yes/no
```
Evan Cho: Makes sense. Ops questions: what are SLAs for response/triage once someone completes probe?
Priya Khatri: Target: triage within 72h, invite decision within 5 business days. For fast-track we want 24h triage and 48h decision.
Maya Lopez: What about incentives? credit vs $$ vs product credits?
Samir Patel: Past data: credits + co-marketing is the most motivating for startups. For enterprise, sandbox + dedicated onboarding beats credits.
Priya Khatri: Proposed incentive tiers: curated: $500 credit + feature feedback badge; fast-track: dedicated onboarding + $2k credit or equivalent engineering time (partner onboarding hours).
Randall-bot: Reminder: please add accepted partners to the dp-onboarding Google Sheet: https://go/reddp/onboard (automated reminder will DM new entries).
Evan Cho: Rollout gates for opening more invites? we should gate on signal quality not just usage.
Priya Khatri: Agreed — launch gates: 1) 10 active partners in each path with baseline usage (>1000 tokens/day or agreed baseline) 2) qualitative feedback: at least 8/10 partners report improvements to their workflow in 3 check-ins 3) no major regression flagged by eval harness on model outputs.
Maya Lopez: For eval harness gate — we should include a small holdback set of prompts from partners to detect regressions. Also add a 'satisfaction' NPS-style quick pulse after 3 weeks.
Samir Patel: Ops constraints: can we commit to the fast-track 24h decision? depends on engineering capacity for onboarding. Suggest 24h triage but 48-72h final if we need technical support slot.
Priya Khatri: OK adjust fast-track decision to 48h if it needs engineering. We'll still aim for 24h triage.
Evan Cho: Implementation detail: in the invite form include a hidden field 'priority_flag' we can set for internal ops to force fast-track. Also add a dropdown for "intended SLA tier" so we can map to Dedicated vs Hosted.
Priya Khatri: Good call. Also adding a tag for "security impact" so security can pre-screen.
Maya Lopez: Coordination ask for PMs: who will own weekly check-ins cadence? I can run the first 4 weeks for curated cohort if product can own fast-track.
Priya Khatri: Thanks Maya — assign curated to Maya, fast-track to Evan for first round. Evan, please confirm capacity.
Evan Cho: I can take fast-track for the next 6 weeks. Will slot 2x 90m blocks for onboarding each week.
Samir Patel: I will publish an ops-runbook snippet for onboarding steps + checklist. Will include: pre-check, probe review, internal engineering reservation, kickoff template, follow-up survey link.
Priya Khatri: Perfect. Final ask: can everyone add their top 3 risks in this thread by EOD? I want to capture before we update the invite form.
Maya Lopez: Will do.
Evan Cho: Added — capacity, biased sample (enterprises only), and probe fatigue.
Samir Patel: Ops risk: onboarding queue growth > capacity; security triage delays.
Priya Khatri: Thanks — will synthesize and push updated invite form by tomorrow morning. :rocket:
